title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distributional discrepancy (sim-to-real gap) between LLM-simulated survey responses and actual human survey responses. This is done by prompting models with synthetic human profiles containing diverse demographic attributes (e.g., age, gender, nationality, religion, socioeconomic status) and comparing the simulated outputs to ground-truth human data from datasets like WorldValueBench, OpinionQA, and EEDI using calibrated quantile curves.
